name: 3Souls
storyline:
3 Souls is an Action-RPG in which the fates of three brothers are intertwined in a single striving to survive and uncover the secrets of a past expedition. Evil looms over Aldmerium, and you are its last hope.

Your ship suffers a crash on approach to the Forsaken Islands — a floating archipelago of ancient ruins, where magic has collided with the technologies of the past. In the role of three heroes: Adrian and his two brothers, whose souls are sealed within the mechanical bodies of the unstoppable Mech and the nimble Drone, you step into a world of grim guardians and magical anomalies. You must gather the fragments of truth about the fate of the previous expedition of the Magical Government.

Build a camp — your only refuge on the cursed lands. Use the unique powers of each of the brothers, uncover the secrets of the ruins, and do everything to save Aldmerium from destruction. Every decision of yours will determine whether this campaign becomes a salvation or an act of retribution.
summary: 3 Souls is an isometric open-world adventure set in a vast archipelago. Control three brothers with unique playstyles, explore forgotten ruins, and gather resources to build your base. Uncover the secrets of the Althmerium in a grand journey where your choices shape the fate of a shattered world.
